This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Mya arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. Her previous owner describes her as active and playful. While in care, she has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to vocalize and snap when approached. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Mya
